# Mariachi

> Mariachi is an opinionated TypeScript backend framework: a modular monolith of `@mariachi/*` packages behind adapters chosen by config, plus a framework-agnostic design library and an explorer for all of it. The opinions exist so that people and coding agents write the same code the same way.

These are the framework's docs, which ship inside `@mariachi/core` (`node_modules/@mariachi/core/docs/`).
Paths are relative to that folder. `mariachi docs` lists them, `mariachi docs <name>` prints one,
`mariachi docs <name> --section <heading>` prints one section, and `mariachi docs --search <words>`
finds the lines that have every word.

- [notifications](./notifications.md): channels, preferences, queued delivery and delivery tracking
- [ai](./ai.md): sessions, budgets, cost, provider fallback, streaming
- [audit](./audit.md): append-only log, hash chain verification, retention and export
- [auth-and-providers](./auth-and-providers.md): identity providers, RBAC, API keys, webhook dedup
- [organizations](./organizations.md): organizations, memberships and invitations in your own database
- [feature-flags](./feature-flags.md): tenant overrides, rollouts, caching
- [storage](./storage.md): `@mariachi/storage` stores files on S3 (and S3-compatible services such as R2, MinIO or Spaces), on local disk or in memory, behind one `StorageClient` interface
- [search](./search.md): `@mariachi/search` indexes your data and queries it with typed fields, filters, facets and query analytics
- [integrations](./integrations.md): How to wrap a third-party API in Mariachi

- [runbook](./runbook.md): ```bash pnpm dev # mariachi dev
- [design](./design.md): the design library: presets, markup contract, overriding at any granularity, tokens
